companyUrls.title: Company websites, careers pages or job-board URLs
companyUrls.description: Company homepages (e.g. https://www.redhat.com) or careers pages: the Actor finds the careers page and its job board. Supported job platforms: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, Workday, Personio and Teamtailor (incl. Teamtailor career sites on their own domain). Direct board URLs work too (e.g. https://boards.greenhouse.io/gitlab). A company on another platform gets one free row explaining why.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Cap on job rows (charged) per company. Newest jobs first.
